title: AWGN Channel
text: Add white Gaussian noise to input signal, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Samples per symbol} sets Samples per symbol; {Mode} sets the variance mode Signal to noise ratio, {SNR (dB)} sets the ratio of signal power to noise power, {Eb/No (dB)} sets the ratio of information bit energy per symbol to noise power spectral, {Es/No (dB)} sets the ratio of information symbol energy per symbol to noise power spectral, {Number of bits per symbol} sets the number of bits in each input symbol, {Input signal power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} sets the mean square power of input, {Specify symbol duration in seconds}, {Symbol period (s)} sets the symbol period in seconds, {Noise variance source}, {Noise variance} sets the variance of white Gaussian noise, {Random number source}, {Initial seed} sets the noise generator initial seed and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Var
ports.summary: Variance of additive white Gaussian noise positive scalar | vector

params.name: Mode
params.values: Variance mode Signal to noise ratio (SNR) (default) | Signal to noise ratio (Eb/No) | Signal to noise ratio (Es/No) | Variance

params.name: SNR (dB)
params.values: Ratio of signal power to noise power 10 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Eb/No (dB)
params.values: Ratio of information bit energy per symbol to noise power spectral density 10 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Es/No (dB)
params.values: Ratio of information symbol energy per symbol to noise power spectral density 10 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Number of bits per symbol
params.values: Number of bits in each input symbol 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Input signal power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)
params.values: Mean square power of input 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Specify symbol duration in seconds
params.values: Specify symbol duration in seconds off (default) | on

params.name: Samples per symbol
params.values: Samples per symbol 1 (default) | positive integer | vector of positive integers

params.name: Symbol period (s)
params.values: Symbol period in seconds [1 2 4] (default) | positive scalar | vector

params.name: Noise variance source
params.values: Noise variance source Parameter (default) | Input port

params.name: Noise variance
params.values: Variance of white Gaussian noise 1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Random number source
params.values: Random number source Global stream (default) | mt19937ar with seed

params.name: Initial seed
params.values: Noise generator initial seed 67 (default) | nonnegative integer

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
